`case_study:adani-hindenburg-2023` | 2023-01-24 | tickers: ADANIENT, ADANIPORTS, ADANIGREEN, ADANIPOWER, ADANIENSOL, ATGL | confidence: verified

On 24 Jan 2023, as Adani Enterprises launched a Rs 20,000 cr FPO, Hindenburg Research alleged stock manipulation and accounting fraud via Mauritius-linked offshore entities, concealed related parties and high leverage, and said seven listed group stocks had ~85% downside on fundamentals. Group market value fell >$100 bn within ~10 days (peak loss ~$150 bn); Adani Enterprises fell ~60%+ from ~Rs 3,400 to ~Rs 1,017 (3 Feb 2023); the fully subscribed FPO was withdrawn on 1 Feb. Partial recovery followed (GQG's $1.9 bn investment Mar 2023; Supreme Court expert committee May 2023 found no regulatory failure; SC Jan 2024 declined further probes). Nov 2024 US DOJ/SEC charges (bribery-related, Adani Green) were a separate shock. Hindenburg shut down in Jan 2025. On 18 Sep 2025 SEBI's final orders closed the related-party allegations (Adicorp, Milestone Tradelinks, Rehvar) with no penalties, holding the transactions were not RPTs under the pre-2021 definition; separate MPS/insider-trading matters were reported as still under examination. Visible-in-advance (pre-report) flags: very high P/E/P/B on capital-intensive businesses, net debt/EBITDA high in several companies, concentrated offshore FPI holders and low free float, small audit firms for large companies, earlier promoter pledges. Lesson: a short report is an allegation, not a verdict; but valuation + leverage + float concentration alone can create a -60% drawdown regardless of the legal outcome. Size positions so a contested governance event is survivable.

**Lesson:** Allegation != verdict, but fragility drives drawdown; position-size
**Spotted early by:** Hindenburg Research (Nate Anderson); earlier CreditSights 'deeply overleveraged' note Aug 2022
**Links:** illustrates -> `insight:short-seller-reports-outcomes`, illustrates -> `strategy:position-sizing`
**Sources:** <https://fortune.com/2023/01/27/hindenburg-report-wipes-out-over-47-billion-from-adani-group-market-cap-in-2-days/> ; <https://www.businessinsider.in/stock-market/news/adani-stocks-have-now-wiped-out-over-100-billion-in-market-value-as-botched-share-sale-piles-on-trouble/articleshow/97557158.cms> ; <https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/sep-2025/order_matter_adicorp.pdf> ; <https://www.moneylife.in/article/adani-group-gets-clean-chit-in-hindenburg-case-sebi-says-no-evidence-of-concealed-related-party-deals/78318.html> ; <https://www.business-standard.com/amp/markets/news/sebi-orders-adani-mps-insider-trading-norms-125091900859_1.html>

`case_study:axon-2017-2025` · tickers US-AXON · confidence: single-source

TASER International renamed itself Axon in April 2017 (after its body-camera and Evidence.com cloud unit) and offered every US police department free body cameras and a year of cloud storage — converting one-time hardware sales into multi-year subscription bundles (cameras + TASER + cloud + later Fusus, drones, AI report-writing 'Draft One'). Founder-CEO Rick Smith got a 2018 market-cap-milestone award. Stock ~$24 (2017 rebrand) [unverified] -> 52-week highs ~$800-880 in 2025 [unverified] ≈ 35x; +600% since 2020 per 2025 coverage. ARR $1.2bn (Q2 2025) from $850m a year earlier; Q4 2025 revenue +39% to $797m; stock +16-17% on Q2 2025 and Q4 2025 prints. Only ~30% of customers on premium plans (Q4 2025) = upsell runway. Split: largely rerating (EV/sales from ~4x to ~20x+) on a recurring-revenue mix shift, plus revenue ~6x [approx]. Drawdown: ~-50% in 2021-22 [unverified]. EARLY SIGNAL visible 2017-19: the free-camera land-grab, rising Evidence.com seats and multi-year bookings (RPO) disclosed each quarter, gross margin rising as software mix grew. Who caught it: growth funds; no single documented name found. LESSON: a hardware incumbent that gives away the device to lock in software subscriptions in a sticky government market can rerate from hardware to SaaS multiples; watch ARR and RPO, not unit sales.

- **Start → end:** ~$24 (Apr 2017) [unverified] → ~$800-880 (2025 highs) [unverified] (~35x)
- **EPS vs rerating:** rerating EV/S ~4x->~20x + revenue ~6x [approx]
- **Max drawdown:** ~-50% (2021-22) [unverified]
- **Early signal:** free body-camera offer; Evidence.com seats; RPO growth; GM rising
- **Who caught it:** not documented
- **Ended/stalled:** not ended (Feb 2026 +17.5% on Q4)
- **Lesson:** razor/blade to SaaS in sticky gov market; track ARR/RPO
- **Sources:** [1](https://www.inc.com/will-yakowicz/taser-chnages-name-axon-body-cameras.html) · [2](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/why-axons-16-surge-signals-new-era-public-safety-tech) · [3](https://coveringcompanies.journalism.cuny.edu/2025/11/05/axon-trades-tasers-for-tech-in-software-and-ai-push/) · [4](https://markets.financialcontent.com/stocks/article/finterra-2026-2-26-the-operating-system-of-public-safety-why-axon-enterprise-axon-just-surged-175)

1. **What the market knows / asks.** The five most-asked Q2 FY27 call topics: (a) FCNR special-window leverage
   economics, (b) NIM trajectory after the October 2026 repo hike, (c) opex and cost-to-income, (d) loan-growth
   guidance, (e) gold-loan LTV and ECL. Consensus sees a NIM/RoA recovery, the Blackstone capital and M&A optionality.
2. **The variable that moves value most:** *sustainable ROE on fully diluted book* = RoA × leverage. Whether the
   RoA gain (1.09% → 1.32% YoY) is franchise (CASA mix, mid-yield shift, fees) or cycle (rate cycle, FCNR window,
   one-offs, write-offs), and whether costs step up (IBA wage settlement due Nov-2027).
3. **Layer most likely to reveal it:** the deposit franchise (Kerala/NRI concentration, quarter-end vs average
   balances) and the Schedule 16 cost lines. **Nobody asked about:** the 2027 IBA wage revision, the DICGC premium,
   ₹5,298 cr of PSL-shortfall deposits, write-off-driven GNPA, or the 59% Kerala deposit share. That is where depth
   paid off below.

body:
1. Read `research_notes/Scoreboard/review_queue.md`. Each entry has the rule, why it is there, the
   resolver's proposal, and evidence links with snippets.
2. Apply the **written rule** strictly, then append one line to
   `research_notes/Scoreboard/review_decisions.jsonl`:
   `{"id": "thesis:paper-call:ICICIGI:q3fy27-combined-ratio-103-5-or-better", "outcome": 1, "value": 102.9, "source": "https://nsearchives…pdf", "source_date": "2027-01-20", "note": "Q3 n-basis incl. CAT, press release p1", "decided_by": "user"}`
   - `outcome`: 1, 0 or `"void"`. A 1 or 0 needs a `source`.
3. The next `resolve.py` run turns the decision into the seed. `apply.sh` writes it to memdb.
4. Write a post-mortem for every call where |p − outcome| > 0.6. `scoreboard.md` lists them under
   "Post-mortems owed".
